title: Cardinal Billing Account Prepayment Credit and Member Tenure: Tenure Rate
content:
**Clause.** A tenure rate multiplies the prepayment credit on a Cardinal Billing Account term payoff: **1.25** when the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy's original inception date is at least 60 whole months before the payoff date, **1.10** when it is at least 24 but under 60 whole months before, and **1.00** otherwise.

Tenure runs in whole months from the original inception date shown on the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy (the start of the policy with Cardinal) to the payoff date.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Whole months from inception to the payoff date | Tenure rate |
|---|---|
| 84 | 1.25 |
| 60 | 1.25 |
| 59 | 1.10 |
| 24 | 1.10 |
| 23 | 1.00 |

**Hypothetical figure.** A credit figured at $4.00 on a policy incepted 30 whole months before the payoff date is multiplied by 1.10.
